Solara — (9.3) CORONA

CONVERGENCE

"Convergence All roads to the same point Convergence"

[Verse 1] A traveler sat at the corner of the bar Drinking something that had no name And said:

Level negative forty-five Something is wrong there The kind of wrong that doesn’t stay in one place

Chaos said: we should discuss the route Disorder said: there is nothing to discuss Disorder said: the route is obvious Chaos said: to you, perhaps Disorder said: to anyone with eyes Chaos said: eyes can be wrong

SOLARA said: are you both done

They were not

[Pre-Chorus] She let them finish Which took a while

And then she said one thing And then she said another And by the third thing Neither of them had anywhere to go And they knew it And she knew they knew it And she let that sit

[Chorus] Convergence All roads to the same point Convergence We go now whether you like it The level is negative forty-five And something down there is wrong And none of you Are going to win this argument Because there is nothing to win There is only where we are going Convergence We move

[Verse 2] Historia said the best path was through the fourth fold She had seventeen reasons She listed them

Aldric said: what about the second fold

Historia said: the second fold has a structural issue from The convergence in cycle four hundred and twelve Which created a lateral pressure anomaly That makes passage seventeen percent more difficult

Aldric said: oh And then Aldric said: But the pressure anomaly collapsed in cycle four hundred and fourteen

Historia said nothing for a full three seconds

Historia said: …yes

Aldric said: so the second fold Historia said: …the second fold

[Pre-Chorus 2] SOLARA looked at Aldric Aldric looked at the ceiling Spida looked at Caterpila Caterpila looked at the door

Disorder said: I knew it was the second fold Chaos said: you said fourth fold ten minutes ago

SOLARA said: second fold. Now.

[Bridge] They moved through the second fold Which was exactly what Aldric said it would be

The air changed at the third gate SOLARA felt it before she saw it The kind of temperature that means Something ahead is producing light That it should not be producing

She said: stay close She said: whatever you see when we arrive Do not react before I do

[Final Chorus] Convergence All roads to the same point Convergence And here we are at negative forty-five Something here is wrong The kind of wrong the traveler mentioned But worse

Stay close

[Outro] The gate opened

And there was Sigma

And Sigma was burning red

The color Sigma should never be

The color that means Something has reached it

SOLARA said nothing for a long time

And then she said: This is not what I expected
